title: Unique alternating family of local determinant functionals
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M an O_X-module sheaf, n a natural number and U an open. There is a unique O_X(U)-alternating n-linear map A from internal dual sections [def-pur-sheaf-hom] of M on U to internal dual sections of its sheafified exterior power [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] on U. It is characterized by (A(φ))_V(a_1∧⋯∧a_n)=det(φ_j,V(a_i)) for every V→U and all tuples a,φ.

source.place: Tags 03CY and 0BRT (determinant inversion); pairingDual and pairingDual_ιMulti_ιMulti. Expanded local argument written by N1; Stacks pages read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03CY and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BRT.

proof.text: For each tuple φ choose the unique functional given by the fixed-tuple construction; the uniqueness prevents any arbitrary data choice. This defines the function underlying A.

Prove additivity and scalar compatibility in each argument by the all-subopen wedge extensionality theorem. On such a wedge, the defining formula reduces these identities to Matrix.det_updateCol_add and Matrix.det_updateCol_smul; a scalar r restricts to O_X(g)(r). If two arguments agree, two columns agree, so Matrix.det_zero_of_column_eq proves the alternating condition. All three identities are implemented in Lean. Columns are rewritten explicitly using Function.update.

The construction has the desired formula by the fixed-tuple theorem. Any other alternating map with that formula agrees on every tuple by all-subopen wedge extensionality, so AlternatingMap.ext gives uniqueness.

lean.statement:
theorem exterior_dual_pairing_local (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (U : X.Opens) :
    ∃! A : ((Scheme.Modules.dual M).val.obj (op U)) [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[X.presheaf.obj (op U)]
        ((Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf M n)).val.obj (op U)),
      ∀ (V : X.Opens) (g : V ⟶ U) (a : Fin n → M.val.obj (op V))
        (φ : Fin n → (Scheme.Modules.dual M).val.obj (op U)),
        (A φ).app (op (Over.mk g)) (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection M n V a) =
          (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (show X.presheaf.obj (op V) from
            (φ j).app (op (Over.mk g)) (a i))).det
